name: Smart Refunds & Returns for WooCommerce
author: WpSolutions+

sections.description:
Turn returns from a support headache into a streamlined, EU-ready system. Smart Refunds & Returns lets shoppers start a refund or return on their own — from My Account, or straight from the WooCommerce order tracking page with no login at all — while you approve, track and settle everything from one native panel on the order screen.

It’s built for the way returns really work: fast for the customer, safe for your bank account, and ready for the EU right of withdrawal.

Install it above and be handling returns in minutes.

Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and the block-based cart and checkout. Fully translatable — translations are delivered through translate.wordpress.org, so the plugin speaks your language as soon as the community has added it.

🔴 The problem: returns cost you time, money and goodwill

  • Inbox chaos. “Where is my return?” emails pile up while staff juggle mail, spreadsheets and sticky notes.
  • The guest-checkout trap. Guests are often the majority of your orders, yet most return plugins force them to log in or register.
  • Unlabelled warehouse boxes. Parcels arrive with no order number and no context, leaving your team guessing.
  • EU compliance. The right of withdrawal needs a timestamped mechanism on a durable medium — ordinary refund plugins aren’t built for it.

🟢 The solution: the complete self-service return journey

  • Self-service declaration from My Account or the tracking page — no password required.
  • One native order panel for statuses, notes and items — no separate dashboard to learn.
  • Automated, timestamped emails that keep customers informed at every step.
  • Total financial control — you settle the money your way; the plugin never touches it on its own.

👤 True guest returns (no login required)

The feature most plugins ignore. A guest opens the standard WooCommerce order-tracking page, enters the order number and billing email they already have, and starts the return inline — secured by a signed access token, so their email never appears in a URL or in the page source. No forced account, no endless back-and-forth.

⚖️ Ready for the EU right of withdrawal

The customer-facing flow is structured as an official declaration of withdrawal — not merely a “request” — and every declaration triggers an acknowledgement email that records the exact date and time of submission on a durable medium, designed with Directive (EU) 2023/2673 in mind (applicable from 19 June 2026). This is a tool to help you; it is not legal advice — please verify your own obligations and your country’s transposition.

🛡️ Zero cash surprises

The plugin handles the logic, workflow and customer updates — you keep full control of the funds. It cannot know how you agreed to refund a customer, so it never creates a WooCommerce refund or a coupon on its own. No accidental double refunds; you stay in control of your cash.

🧩 No learning curve for your team

Every return is a native WooCommerce order status with its own panel on the order edit screen — no external dashboard. If your staff knows WooCommerce, they already know this.

Feature tour

Customer self-service

  • Return button in My Account
  • Guest return button on the WooCommerce order-tracking page — no account needed
  • [smart_refund_form] shortcode to embed a return form on any page
  • Guest access secured by a signed token

Form builder

  • Unlimited fields with drag-and-drop
  • Text, textarea, checkbox, radio and select fields
  • Extra field types — multi-select, HTML, and file / image upload so customers can attach photos of a defect [PRO]

Workflow & statuses

  • Requested, Approved, Completed / Refused, plus customer-initiated Cancelled
  • Reopen a closed return at any time, without emailing the customer
  • Full workflow — Awaiting customer reply, Awaiting return, Checking returned items, In progress [PRO]
  • Customers can cancel their own declaration, with the original timestamp kept for your records

Communication

  • Immediate timestamped acknowledgement email on submission
  • Notify multiple recipients — e.g. warehouse and finance
  • Choose, per change, whether the customer is emailed
  • A transactional email for every workflow step [PRO]
  • Custom return instructions sent automatically when you accept a return [PRO]

Items, fees & rules

  • Return the whole order in one click
  • Record or edit a return from the order screen — perfect for phone or email requests
  • Let customers choose exactly which items and quantities to return [PRO]
  • Refund shipping cost and additional order fees [PRO]
  • Conditional visibility by days since order, product, category, payment method or user role [PRO]
  • Auto-hide the return button after a set window [PRO]

Free vs Pro

Everything listed under “Included in Free” is fully functional in this plugin — nothing here is locked, metered or time-limited. The Pro features are not part of this download at all; they ship as a separate plugin.

Included in Free

  • Guest returns from the order-tracking page — no account needed
  • [smart_refund_form] standalone return page
  • EU withdrawal-ready, timestamped acknowledgement email
  • Native WooCommerce order status and admin panel
  • 5 return statuses (requested, approved, completed, cancelled, refused), plus reopening
  • Unlimited form fields — text, textarea, checkbox, radio and select
  • Record and edit a return from the order screen, for requests that arrive by phone or email
  • Customer status-update emails, with per-change control over whether one is sent
  • Multi-recipient admin emails (warehouse / finance)
  • Return Policy link in emails
  • HPOS and block checkout compatible

Pro adds

  • Full 9-status workflow (awaiting customer reply, awaiting return, checking items, in progress), with an email for every step
  • File / image upload, multi-select and HTML field types
  • Partial returns — customers choose which items and quantities
  • Refund shipping cost and extra order fees
  • Conditional visibility rules (days since order, category, payment method, user role)
  • Auto-hide the return button after a set window
  • Custom return instructions, sent automatically on acceptance

Features marked [PRO] are available in Smart Refunds & Returns for WooCommerce Pro, which is a separate plugin. Stop losing hours to manual return emails — give customers the smooth return they expect, and give yourself peace of mind.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New, or copy it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Smart Refunds and enable the return button.
  4. Build your return form under the Refund Form section.
  5. Optional standalone guest page: create a page containing the [smart_refund_form] shortcode and select it in the refund form page setting.
sections.faq:
Do customers need an account to start a return?

No. Guests can start a return from the WooCommerce order tracking page using their order number and billing email. Registered customers can also use My Account.

Does the plugin refund the money automatically?

No, and that is deliberate. It cannot know how you agreed to refund the customer, so it never creates a WooCommerce refund or a coupon on its own. You settle the refund however you agreed, then mark the return as completed.

Is it compliant with the EU right of withdrawal?

The customer-facing flow uses withdrawal and declaration wording and sends a timestamped acknowledgement on a durable medium, designed with Directive (EU) 2023/2673 in mind. This is not legal advice; please verify your own obligations and your country’s transposition.

Does it work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce custom order tables and with the block-based cart and checkout.

Where do returns appear in the admin?

Each return sets a dedicated status on the order and adds a panel to the order edit screen where you move it through the workflow.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes, and it is a separate plugin rather than an unlock code — nothing in this free plugin is disabled waiting for a licence. Pro adds the full workflow with a transactional email for every step, conditional visibility rules, partial returns, shipping and fee refunds, and the upload / multi-select / HTML field types. See the Pro page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Unlimited form fields are now part of the free plugin, and the one-field limit is gone.
  • Admin emails can now go to several recipients, and you can decide per change whether the customer is emailed.
  • Answers and quantities can now be edited from the order screen in the free plugin.
  • The Pro features are no longer part of this download: they now ship as a separate plugin instead of being included and switched off.
  • Translation files are no longer bundled; translations come from translate.wordpress.org.

1.0.2

  • Reopening a closed return is now available in the free edition too, and never emails the customer.
  • The Reopen button now uses the standard WooCommerce button styling, matching the order screen.

1.0.1

  • The upgrade links now open the secure hosted checkout in a new tab for a smoother, more reliable purchase.
  • Added the upgrade prompt to the Return instructions setting.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Guest returns from the WooCommerce order tracking page, secured by a signed access token.
  • [smart_refund_form] shortcode for a standalone return page.
  • Withdrawal-friendly wording and a timestamped acknowledgement email on a durable medium.
  • Return workflow with a dedicated order status, admin panel and transactional emails.
  • The plugin never creates a WooCommerce refund or coupon on its own.
  • Compatible with HPOS and the block-based cart and checkout.
